bagPolicy.summary: All bags are subject to search, and large bags are prohibited. The venue FAQ does not set a specific size in inches.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Brooklyn Bowl has no dedicated parking lot and points drivers to reservable nearby parking.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Brooklyn Bowl. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Outside food, alcohol and other drinks are prohibited. The venue is cashless except at the box office and coat check, and staff can load cash onto a debit card.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Brooklyn Bowl was built to ADA and state accessibility requirements, and its public spaces are wheelchair friendly. Staff are on hand to help, so ask to speak with a manager if you run into any problems.

reEntry.summary: The venue FAQ states that guests can be searched each time they enter or re-enter, but does not guarantee re-entry for every ticketed concert.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office opens when doors open on show days. The FAQ does not state a separate will-call pickup time.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The box office opens at the event’s listed door time; entry may involve a pat-down, security wand or metal detector and bag search.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
